deck.en: A pause in the lane to tidy the bouquet's paper.

intro.ko: 골목을 걷다 꽃다발의 포장을 살짝 정돈해요. 코발트 윈드브레이커와 크림 니트, 네이비 팬츠가 꽃의 부드러운 색을 또렷하게 받쳐 줍니다.
intro.en: A small pause to straighten the bouquet's wrapping. A cobalt windbreaker, cream knit and navy trousers frame the flowers' softer colours.
intro.de: Eine kleine Pause, um das Papier am Blumenstrauß zu richten. Kobaltblaue Windjacke, cremefarbener Strick und marineblaue Hose rahmen die zarten Blumenfarben.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A LITTLE COLOUR FOR THE WALK.

tip.ko: 바람이 선선한 날엔 얇은 겉옷을 열어 겹쳐 입고, 꽃다발은 손목이 편한 높이로 받쳐 보세요.
tip.en: On a cool breezy day, wear a light jacket open over a knit and hold the bouquet at a comfortable height.
tip.de: An einem kühlen, leicht windigen Tag eine leichte Jacke offen über Strick tragen und den Strauß bequem halten.
